fixes.explanation: That's it, baker. Verse 8 says, “Instead, you are to open your hand to him and freely loan him whatever he needs.” Think about a fist. You can't hold anything out with a fist, and you can't take anything either. An open hand can do both, and “freely” is the word that does the work.

Bow is a fair guess, because people do bow to whoever's in charge. But verse 6 never mentions bowing. It says Israel will “…rule over many nations but be ruled by none.” Rule is the word that fits that blank, baker.
